name: CloseTheBooks: Financial Reporting, Consolidation & IFRS
description: Simulation placing participants at the helm of the Group Finance function of Condor Holdings during a Q3 financial close. Covers subsidiary review, intercompany elimination, FX translation, NCI calculation, IFRS 15/16/IAS 36 adjustments, and audit interaction.

Consolidation Worksheet

Enter the correct elimination and translation amounts for the group consolidation.

IFRS Adjustment Package

Resolve three IFRS issues: revenue recognition (IFRS 15), lease classification (IFRS 16), and goodwill impairment (IAS 36).

Audit Interaction

The external auditors have raised three queries. For each, decide whether to accept the adjustment or defend your position.

Query 1: The auditor believes the Colombia warranty provision should be $210,000 (not $185,000) based on updated claims data. Accept their higher estimate or defend your original figure?

Query 2: The auditor questions the 9.5% incremental borrowing rate used for the IFRS 16 lease liability, suggesting 10.2% based on market comparables. Accept or defend?

Query 3: The auditor questions the no-impairment conclusion for Spain goodwill, noting the 22% EBIT miss. Accept impairment or defend the VIU analysis?

text.en: Distinguish an impairment indicator from an impairment and defend an IAS 36 conclusion against a challenge that rests on the indicator alone
text.es: Distinguir un indicio de deterioro de un deterioro y defender una conclusión según la NIC 36 frente a una objeción que se apoya solo en el indicio

text.en: Prepare the core consolidation entries, namely intragroup revenue and unrealised profit eliminations, closing-versus-average translation and the non-controlling interest, and explain which line each moves
text.es: Preparar los asientos básicos de consolidación, es decir, la eliminación de ingresos intragrupo y de beneficios no realizados, la conversión a tipo de cierre y tipo medio y los intereses minoritarios, y explicar qué partida mueve cada uno

text.en: Evaluate auditor proposals on evidence and materiality and decide which adjustments to accept and which to defend
text.es: Evaluar las propuestas del auditor según la evidencia y la materialidad y decidir qué ajustes aceptar y cuáles defender

text.en: Apply a risk-of-misstatement ranking to allocate a fixed review budget across subsidiaries and assess the cost of concentrating it
text.es: Aplicar una clasificación por riesgo de incorrección para repartir un presupuesto fijo de revisión entre filiales y valorar el coste de concentrarlo

text.en: Critique a conservative, audit-ready close posture against IFRS neutrality and recommend the posture a group controller should take to the audit committee
text.es: Criticar una postura de cierre conservadora y pensada para el auditor frente a la neutralidad de las NIIF, y recomendar la postura que un controller de grupo debe llevar al comité de auditoría
